title: Building better tools... and making MCP's and skills to use tools!
author: Lumpy_Conference6640
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/js3h0467f4wh1.png

So I got my Gemini Sub for free because I was using Flow, and I wanted the extra bandwidth space. However, with Argon, we've now have a frontier model, and playing around with Antigravity.  
  
One sticky recurring issue is the use of sprites. Not sure if it's laziness or wanting a system that keeps up with ever-increasing projects. But I used an open-source program, completely re-coded it in Vite and Python, and finally layered in a comfy UI/Stable Diffusion into it. With the MCP protocols, I can now no use Antigravity to generate infinite pictures within a LoRa, and step-iterate custom animations for use internally or exported to Godot.
